facts.function: parts of beer dispensing taps and valves
facts.form: valve head, coupling head, stout faucet, spare faucet parts

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8481 covers taps, cocks, valves and parts thereof; Section XVI note 2 (parts) and chapter 84 notes checked, parts of heading 8481 goods go to 8481.90
GRI 6: 8481.90 parts, then material line; copper assumed

rejected_alternatives.reason: for complete faucets/valves; the goods are parts
applies if other materials such as plastic or stainless steel

missing_facts: Material of the parts (copper alloy, stainless steel or plastic)
classify separately: coupling head, stout faucet, spare parts (faucet itself would be 8481.80)
classification.rationale: The first-named article, a valve head, is a part of a tap or valve under heading 8481; 8481.90 covers parts by material. Brass or copper is assumed, typical of beer taps. No ruling on dispensing taps was found, and F83298 (water treatment faucet kit) was not relied on.
